Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel.name: Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel
Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel.description: Required to use the Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.

Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.name: Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade
Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.description:
You may swap between firing modes at the start of combat or as an action during combat.

Required before use:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.mlYhAxuDlI3fP9hq]{Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel}

Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.name: Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery
Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.description:
Required for use by the Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.

Each battery contains enough charge to power 8 shots. The battery can be recharged in any power port in 1 hour.

NCPD Crime Database.name: NCPD Crime Database
NCPD Crime Database.description:
Agent App.

Requires CitiNet access in Night City. Allows user to research crime database.

Trauma Team MedScan.name: Trauma Team MedScan
Trauma Team MedScan.description:
Agent App.

Requires CitiNet access. MedScan can connect you to a Trauma Team Remote Specialist but their actual guidance costs extra.

For an increased fee, a remote Trauma Specialist can be hired to direct the user through an entire 4-hour procedure.

Rules related to cost of hiring and procedures allowed to be done with this App are contained in Black Chrome rulebook for this item.
